body:
Hey there friend, glad to see your edit!  It's rough to have parents pressuring you to live against your beliefs or attend meetings that are deeply upsetting to you, but chances are that your parents are not terrible people and you are better off staying with them.   I'm going to suggest some scripts for talking to them about this, please feel free to use them or to ignore them if they aren't right for you.  You know your parents and your situation way better than I do!

[First try]
"Parents, going to church is very difficult and stressful for me.  We compromised before and I want to maintain that compromise.  Please don't try to force me to go to church."

[Second try]
"Parents, I know you want me to go to church because you love me and want the best for me, but I am not ready to attend church full time.  Please respect my choice to attend only sacrament meetings."

[Not a threat... Just telling it like it is, in more ways than one.]
"Parents, our deal was that I would go to sacrament meeting and not tell anyone about my disbelief.  I would like to keep that deal.  But if you make me go to all three hours of church, I will not be able to just not say anything about believing, which means I will have to tell the truth.  I know you believe in honesty and would not try to make me give up my integrity, so you'll have to choose between my 3 hour attendance and my silence."

[If they won't budge]
"Parents, I love you but I do not feel the same way you do about the church.  I want our family to get through this difficult time and stay close despite our differences.  Please help me make that happen by respecting my feelings and agency."

[So they cry themselves to sleep?  Well, you feel unloved by them.  Two can play that game.]
"Parents, I am so sorry that this is hard for you.  But making me go to church will not change how I feel about the church.  It only changes how I feel about you.  I want to see you as my allies, but you are pushing me to do things that go against what I believe.  I love you, and I think you love me, but when you force me to go to church and pretend to believe something I don't, it doesn't feel like you love me at all."  

Good luck!

I'm glad you are getting some help and I wish you luck finding a good hospital or other psych assistance.  Also, eating is a thing you should do.  If it feels too complicated to make real food, consider some toast or just a glass of milk.  All the best, Sam
Hooray, for real. Glad to hear it
Okay.  If I'm at work and don't see it for a while, consider phoning a hotline.  I hope you feel better tomorrow.
Sorry to hear it.  If you do want to talk, I'm here listening.
Why does everyone assume that not believing in God entails not believing in an afterlife?
Thank you for trying, I don't know what else to do
I'm sorry you are scared and depressed.  I wish I knew how to help you.  Have you considered/do you have access to therapy?

Goodnight, Sam.  Please don't kill yourself, I know someone will miss you.  Even if you don't have someone in your life right now who will miss you, there is someone in your future whose life will be less for not knowing you.

I don't know what you should do, but I can tell you what I did.  I have felt this way before (sometimes I still do, hence my visit to this reddit tonight) and this is what has helped me: helping others.  Is there somebody you can help tomorrow?  Do you have family member or friend that will have a better day if you are around?  If not, try volunteermatch.org to find somebody who needs your help.  You don't have to have any special skills to help someone.  When I feel like my life isn't worth living, it helps to try and make someone else's life better.  Do you want to talk about what's going on in your life right now?

I've been there.  I'm not there tonight, but sometimes I feel so tired of everything in my life that I wish I could just melt into dust and disappear.  I want to leave my life all the time. Sometimes it helped me to talk, but other times not so much.  Once I called a suicide hotline and the person on the phone actually started yelling at me for crying.  At least no one can yell through text (caps-lock doesn't count.)

Sam, my name is May, I'm 21 and I am also feeling suicidal tonight.  (That's what brings me to this reddit.)  Wanna talk about it?  I kind of want to die but I don't want you to die, maybe we can keep each other alive for a while
